q1_issues.issue: "in the final phase" is encoded with the head `During`, but the instruction set pins an oblique's head to the preposition actually used and states that `During` renders only the word "during" (here it should be `In`).

`Location` is attached to the raid-group witness — an entity, which the instruction set forbids for `Location` — and no preposition in the text states that the raids were in London; "London" is only an attributive name modifier.
`Ordinal`'s scale slot is filled with the entity's own kind (`phase`), which is neither the associated event nor an explicit "-est" dimension, the only two fillers the instruction set defines.

q2_gaps: attributive proper-noun modifier on a common-noun head ("the London raids") — the name rules cover only a name that names the referent itself ("the Brindle estuary"), and the compound-kind rules give no route for a place-name modifier that does not name the referent
coordinated modifiers sharing one head noun ("a cocaine and money laundering ring") — coordination is defined for clauses, VPs and NPs, not for two modifiers of a single nominal
an ordinal on a stage/part noun ("the final phase") with no associated event and no "-est" dimension to fill `Ordinal`'s scale slot
notes: The bounded count (`CardinalityAtLeast` 101), the two-year duration `Measure`, the reduced-relative "investigating" as an event with the operation as `Agent`, and the phase/operation `PartOf` are all handled per spec. Group-only (no per-member rule) is right for the aggregate predicate "launched the raids".
